task.question: Among instruments with cap_tier 'MID', which ticker has the highest average daily traded volume? Return the ticker.

result.question: Among instruments with cap_tier 'MID', which ticker has the highest average daily traded volume? Return the ticker.
result.cited_sql: SELECT i.ticker, AVG(p.volume) as avg_volume FROM instruments i JOIN prices p ON i.instrument_id = p.instrument_id WHERE i.cap_tier = 'MID' GROUP BY i.ticker ORDER BY avg_volume DESC LIMIT 1
